channel.title: Detroit Sports Nation - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Detroit Sports Nation (detroitsportsnation.com)

item.title: Where the Detroit Lions’ 2025 Draft Class Ranks Among All NFL Teams
item.description: ESPN’s Aaron Schatz ranked the Detroit Lions No. 22 in his 2025 NFL rookie class production list. Here’s how Detroit compared to the Bears, Packers, and Vikings.

item.title: NFL Insider Says Lions May Lose Out On Dream Offensive Coordinator
item.description: An NFL insider projects the Detroit Lions could lose top offensive coordinator candidate Mike McDaniel, with the Cleveland Browns expected to hire him as head coach.

item.title: Holly Campbell Reveals the Relentless Life of Lions HC Dan Campbell
item.description: Detroit Lions coach Dan Campbell’s wife Holly reveals the brutal grind of NFL life, including sleeping at the facility, 3:30 a.m. wake-ups, and the mental toll of coaching.

item.title: Dan Orlovsky Does Not Mince Words When Asked About Detroit Lions OC Job
item.description: Dan Orlovsky made his feelings crystal clear on The Pat McAfee Show, saying he would “very much” love to become the Detroit Lions’ next offensive coordinator and gushing about the organization, Jared Goff, and the culture in Detroit.

item.title: Pros and Cons of Detroit Lions Hiring Dan Orlovsky as OC
item.description: Dan Orlovsky says he’d love to be the Detroit Lions’ offensive coordinator, but would it actually make sense? Here are the real pros, the major red flags, and why it’s almost certainly not happening.

item.title: Latest Report on Mike McDaniel Is Music to Detroit Lions Fans’ Ears
item.description: NFL insider reports Mike McDaniel may prefer a great OC job over a weak head coaching role, potentially keeping the Detroit Lions in the hunt for their next offensive coordinator.

item.title: Viral Photo Confirms Mike McDaniel Was in Detroit for Lions OC Talks
item.description: A photo circulating on social media appears to confirm that Mike McDaniel was in Detroit amid reports he met with the Lions about their offensive coordinator opening.

item.title: Report: Zac Robinson Headed to Detroit for Key Interview
item.description: Former Falcons OC Zac Robinson is traveling to Detroit to interview for the Lions’ offensive coordinator vacancy. He has a strong history with Jared Goff from their time with the Rams.

item.title: Pros and Cons of the Detroit Lions Hiring Zac Robinson as OC
item.description: Breaking down the pros and cons of the Detroit Lions hiring Falcons offensive coordinator Zac Robinson, including his fit with Jared Goff, Sean McVay roots, play-calling experience, and potential risks.

item.title: Report: John Harbaugh Nearing Agreement That Could Change the NFL Landscape
item.description: ESPN reports the New York Giants are finalizing a deal to hire longtime Ravens coach John Harbaugh. A Super Bowl champion and one of the NFL’s winningest coaches, Harbaugh could soon be leading Big Blue.
